findings.behavior: Stores std::vector<WorldSnapshot>; each snapshot owns a full std::vector<EntityState>.
findings.implication: In-memory history scales approximately with revisions × entities even when only a small entity subset changes.

findings.behavior: Validates the complete timeline, opens a temporary file, and serializes every entity of every snapshot before replacing the destination.
findings.implication: Persisting one new revision rewrites the complete historical archive rather than appending only the new revision/delta.

findings.behavior: Parses every snapshot and every entity into full WorldSnapshot objects.
findings.implication: Random time/region access and startup cost are coupled to complete archive size.

findings.behavior: The system already has deterministic entity-level diffs between revisions.
findings.implication: A natural delta representation already exists semantically; persistence simply does not exploit it yet.

decision: PROMOTE APPEND-ONLY DELTA + PERIODIC CHECKPOINT STORAGE AS REQUIRED INFRASTRUCTURE FOR MINIMAL-WORK HISTORY. Do not claim generic delta journaling as standalone novelty.
exactnessRequirement: Reconstructing any revision from checkpoint+deltas must produce an entity-sorted snapshot byte/field-equivalent to the immutable full snapshot semantics.
